title: Kindness and perseverance
intro: Kindness to everyone, and staying firm on the right path – two signs of real faith.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah (SWT) tells the Prophet (SAW): be easy-going with people, tell them to do good, and turn away from those who act ignorantly. <small>(Qur’an, Al-A‘raf 7:199)</small>

In a time of selfishness, narrow-mindedness and little care for others, it is a real joy to meet someone who is kind and who feels for other people’s problems. Such people are true jewels that always shine, whatever the situation.

A salam, a nice word and a smile given to someone is a good deed – a sadaqah (charity). Muslim men and women are asked to be friendly and kind to all people, in their words and in their actions. Allah describes the believers as kind and merciful people who help others.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah (SWT) asks: what is the steep path? It is freeing a slave, or feeding – on a day of hunger – an orphan relative or a poor person in need, and being one of those who believe and urge each other to patience and to mercy. They are the successful ones. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Balad 90:11–18)</small>

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “In their love, mercy and kindness to one another, the believers are like one body: if one part of it hurts, the whole body feels the pain and the fever.” (Bukhari)
The goal of being kind is to make life better for the people around us. We can do it only if we feel for others, understand them, and care about them just as we care about ourselves.
We show the faith in our heart by steadily doing what Allah commanded and leaving what He forbade.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Those who say “Our Lord is Allah” and then stay firm on it – the angels come down to them saying: do not be afraid and do not be sad, but be glad of the Jannah you were promised. <small>(Qur’an, Fussilat 41:30)</small>

Every believer should keep checking themselves: am I staying firm on the right path? We should thank Allah for our steadiness and ask Him to keep us on the right path. We should also keep improving the steps we take towards Allah (SWT).
Through perseverance we are saved from evil, we come closer to Jannah, and our good wishes come true.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: One of the Companions asked the Prophet (SAW): “O Messenger of Allah, tell me something about Islam that I will never need to ask anyone about after you.” He said: “Say: ‘I believe in Allah’, and then stay firm on it.” (Muslim)
That is why we need to keep going with sincere intentions, useful words and good deeds.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Kindness, and perseverance in doing good deeds, show our faith and our obedience to Allah (SWT).

practice.title: Kindness or perseverance?
practice.prompt: Which quality does each example show more?

items.text: Greeting a classmate with a smile and salam
Sharing your lunch with a hungry friend
Helping a new student who feels lonely
Praying every day, even when you are tired
Coming to maktab every week, even in the snow
Learning a surah a little bit every day until you know it

practice.title: Match the pairs
pairs: A smile and a kind word

questions.q: Which of these is counted as sadaqah?
options: A salam, a nice word and a smile
Only giving a lot of money

questions.q: How did the Prophet (SAW) describe the believers?
options: Like one body: when one part hurts, the whole body feels it
Like a crowd at a game

questions.q: What is the goal of being kind to others?
options: To make life better for the people around us

questions.q: What does the angels’ message in Fussilat promise to those who stay firm?
options: Jannah – do not be afraid and do not be sad

questions.q: What did the Prophet (SAW) tell the Companion to say?
options: “I believe in Allah”, then stay firm on it

practice.title: Questions and talking with your teacher
prompts: 💬 Which behaviour of Muslims is counted as sadaqah?
🫀 How did the Prophet (SAW) describe the relations between Muslims?
🎯 What is the goal of being kind to other people?
🧗 What does perseverance in faith mean?
🤔 Talk with your teacher: some perseverance is useful and some is harmful. Can you think of an example of each?
